findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router is reachable and active but call_log_exists is false and log file /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl is not present

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service initializes and writes to its configured call_log.jsonl path for telemetry and observability.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call volume, and failure metrics.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: Hardcoded Direct LLM Provider Calls in Emergency Alerts

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys rather than querying model router endpoint

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures policy governance, unified logging, fallback management, and metrics tracking for emergency alerting.
